metadata.title: Stocks Selloff, AI Fears Bond Yields, Crypto Vote | September 15 Barron’s Daily<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Bonds, AI, Crypto…It’s Make-or-Break Time for Markets
We’re back in the danger zone. The 10-year Treasury yield hit a new 19-year high above 5% early Tuesday—that should put markets on red alert.
